sim.principle.victory: A stable base balances energy, water, air, food, and radiation protection.
sim.principle.soporte-vital: Air comes first. Without oxygen and water loops, nothing else matters.
sim.principle.soporte-vital.oxigeno: Air comes first. Without oxygen nothing else matters.
sim.principle.soporte-vital.agua: Water is spent on everything: drinking, breathing, and growing food.
sim.principle.soporte-vital.alimentos: Plants take time. You must sow before hunger arrives.
sim.principle.exposicion: Radiation accumulates and never goes down.
sim.principle.plazo.proteccion: Radiation shielding cannot be improvised at the last minute.
sim.principle.plazo.racha: A stable base keeps a safety margin every single day.
sim.principle.objetivos: All mission objectives must be met before the window closes.
sim.suggestion.victory: Review your final resource margins or try a higher difficulty.
sim.suggestion.soporte-vital: Build the generator before day 4 and supply it with water.
sim.suggestion.soporte-vital.oxigeno: Build the oxygen generator before day 4 and give it water.
sim.suggestion.soporte-vital.agua: Explore southeast on the first day and place an extractor on the ice.
sim.suggestion.soporte-vital.alimentos: Build the greenhouse in the first three days and keep it powered.
sim.suggestion.exposicion: Place the shelter two days before the storm and save battery energy to use it.
sim.suggestion.plazo: Use all your action points during the first days.
sim.suggestion.plazo.proteccion: Reserve 14 materials for the shelter before expanding the base.
sim.suggestion.plazo.racha: Keep reserves above the threshold for several consecutive days.
sim.suggestion.plazo.otro: Use all your action points during the first days.
sim.suggestion.escasez: Collect minerals before running out of materials.
sim.suggestion.objetivos: Check the objectives list each day to see what is still missing.
